title: Resveratrol inhibits LPS-induced apoptosis in bovine mammary epithelial cells: the role of PGC1alpha-SIRT3 axis.
authors: Ouyang, Lu; Tang, Huilun; Liu, Zilin; Tian, Yuan; Gao, Xin; Peng, Tao; Wang, Zuo; Lan, Xinyi; Shen, Weijun; Xiao, Dingfu; Wan, Fachun; Liu, Lei
journal: In vitro cellular & developmental biology. Animal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇通过PGC1alpha-SIRT3轴抑制LPS诱导的牛乳腺上皮细胞凋亡，仅含分子对接预测小分子与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Resveratrol (Res) is a bioactive dietary component and alleviates apoptosis in multiple cell types. However, its effect and mechanism on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced bovine mammary epithelial cells (BMEC) apoptosis, which commonly happens in dairy cows with mastitis, is unknown. We hypothesized that Res would inhibit LPS-induced apoptosis in BMEC through SIRT3, a NAD + -dependent deacetylase activated by Res. To test the dose-response effect on apoptosis, 0-50 muM Res were incubated with BMEC for 12 h, followed by 250 mug/mL LPS treatment for 12 h. To investigate the role of SIRT3 in Res-mediated alleviation of apoptosis, BMEC were pretreated with 50 muM Res for 12 h, then incubated with si-SIRT3 for 12 h and were finally treated with 250 mug/mL LPS for 12 h. Res dose-dependently promoted the cell viability and protein levels of Bcl-2 (Linear P < 0.001) but decreased protein levels of Bax, Caspase-3 and Bax/Bcl-2 (Linear P < 0.001). TUNEL assays indicated that cellular fluorescence intensity declined with the rising doses of Res. Res also dose-dependently upregulated SIRT3 expression, but LPS had the opposite effect. SIRT3 silencing abolished these results with Res incubation. Mechanically, Res enhanced the nuclear translocation of PGC1alpha, the transcriptional cofactor for SIRT3. Further molecular docking analysis revealed that Res could directly bind to PGC1alpha by forming a hydrogen bond with Tyr-722. Overall, our data suggested that Res relieved LPS-induced BMEC apoptosis through the PGC1alpha-SIRT3 axis, providing a basis for further in vivo investigations of applying Res to relieve mastitis in dairy cows.
abstract_zh: 白藜芦醇（Res）是一种具有生物活性的膳食成分，可缓解多种细胞类型的凋亡。然而，其对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的牛乳腺上皮细胞（BMEC）凋亡（奶牛乳腺炎中常见现象）的作用及机制尚不清楚。我们假设Res通过SIRT3（一种由Res激活的NAD+依赖性去乙酰化酶）抑制LPS诱导的BMEC凋亡。为测试凋亡的剂量-效应关系，将0-50 μM Res与BMEC孵育12小时，随后用250 μg/mL LPS处理12小时。为探究SIRT3在Res介导的凋亡缓解中的作用，BMEC先用50 μM Res预处理12小时，再与si-SIRT3孵育12小时，最后用250 μg/mL LPS处理12小时。Res剂量依赖性地促进细胞活力和Bcl-2蛋白水平（线性P < 0.001），但降低Bax、Caspase-3及Bax/Bcl-2的蛋白水平（线性P < 0.001）。TUNEL检测表明，细胞荧光强度随Res剂量增加而下降。Res还剂量依赖性地上调SIRT3表达，而LPS则产生相反效果。SIRT3沉默消除了Res孵育带来的这些结果。机制上，Res增强了PGC1α（SIRT3的转录辅因子）的核转位。进一步的分子对接分析显示，Res可通过与Tyr-722形成氢键直接结合PGC1α。总体而言，我们的数据表明Res通过PGC1α-SIRT3轴缓解LPS诱导的BMEC凋亡，为未来应用Res缓解奶牛乳腺炎的体内研究提供了基础。
